spec.description: The sbots alert queries, the usage and health stats and the raw sbots logs from Loki, for on-call triage.

spec.expr: sum by (bot, platform) (count_over_time({app="sbots"} |= "[stats] type=message" | regexp `bot=(?P<bot>\S+) platform=(?P<platform>\S+)` [$__interval]))

spec.description: One [stats] type=message line per message that reaches a bot.
spec.title: Messages per bot and platform

spec.description: Requests dropped after the request processing timeout.
spec.title: Timeouts

spec.description: Messages the platform delivered more than once (#1432).
spec.title: Duplicates skipped

spec.description: Messages whose processing ended with an error.
spec.title: Failed messages

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {app="sbots"} |= "[stats] type=message" | regexp `bot=(?P<bot>\S+).*latency_ms=(?P<l>\d+)` | unwrap l [$__interval]) by (bot)

spec.description: 95th percentile of the processing time of a message.
spec.title: Latency p95 (ms)

spec.description: Approximate: the ERROR and WARN lines that mention media.
spec.title: Media errors

spec.description: JVM heap in use, logged once a minute. The JVM runs with -Xmx256m.
spec.title: Heap used (MB)

spec.description: -1 means the value was not found/read.
spec.title: DB and disk size (MB)

spec.description: mem_available and mem_free are the lowest values in the bucket so memory pressure shows up; -1 means the OS value was unavailable.
spec.title: Host memory (MB)

spec.description: Load averages from /proc/loadavg; -1.00 means the OS value was unavailable.
spec.title: System load (1m / 5m / 15m)

spec.description: System-wide CPU utilisation from the JDK MX bean; -1 means it was unavailable.
spec.title: CPU usage (%)

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {app="sbots"} |= "llm_interaction" | json | line_format "{{.message}}" | json | unwrap latency_ms [$__interval]) by (bot)

spec.description: Time of the completion, per bot.
spec.title: LLM latency p95 (ms)

spec.description: Interactions silenced because both providers' quotas are exhausted (the quota alert counts these).
spec.title: LLM quota exhausted

spec.description: Text, reuse and silent decisions: the silent/reuse/text ratio.
spec.title: LLM replies by action

spec.expr: sum by (failure) (count_over_time({app="sbots"} |= "llm_interaction" | json | line_format "{{.message}}" | json | failure!="" [$__interval]))

spec.description: Interactions that ended without a reply for a reason other than the model choosing silence.
spec.title: LLM failures by reason

spec.description: Fallback provider asked, and prompts refused before any provider (oversized, missing credentials).
spec.title: LLM fallbacks and local rejections

spec.expr: sum by (bot) (sum_over_time({app="sbots"} |= "llm_interaction" | json | line_format "{{.message}}" | json | unwrap prompt_tokens [$__interval]))

spec.description: Estimated prompt tokens per bot (4 characters per token: the providers report no usage).
spec.title: LLM prompt tokens (estimated)

spec.expr: sum by (provider_errors) (count_over_time({app="sbots"} |= "llm_interaction" | json | line_format "{{.message}}" | json | provider_errors!="" [$__interval]))

spec.description: Provider calls that failed over HTTP, as provider:status (for example gemini:404). The provider message is in the provider_error key of the log line.
spec.title: LLM provider HTTP errors
